from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly EPS data point from a company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the document")
    year: str | None = Field(description="The year this report covers (e.g., '2019', '2020')")
    quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter this report covers (e.g., 'Q1', '第一')")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value reported for this quarter")
    eps_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of EPS, e.g., '元/股'")
    previous_year_basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="EPS from the previous year for comparison (if provided in document)")
    year_over_year_change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year change percentage (if provided)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt or context anchoring this EPS figure in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_eps_records: list[QuarterlyEPSRecord]
